description: Named Aero Hand poses on voice: 'Jarvis peace' / 'peace sign', 'flip me off', 'rock on', 'surf's up' (shaka), and 'lululil' (unclear transcription — maybe 'I love you' ASL; confirm with Jake). The voice session runs one deterministic command that moves the hand to the pose quickly. Build on third_party/aero_hand/scripts/performance.py (SDK set_joint_positions, 7 joints, port auto-detected; LEFT hand). Make it easy to add poses.

results.notes: Jake: 'lululil' is the Chinese 666 sign (liù liù liù, 'that's cool'): thumb and pinky up, other fingers down (same shape as the 6 sign / shaka). Also add Chinese one-hand counting 1 to 10 as poses, so 'Jarvis count to ten' runs 1..10 and 'Jarvis seven' shows one number: 1 index; 2 index+middle; 3 middle+ring+pinky (OK-style, thumb touching index) or the index+middle+ring form; 4 four fingers, thumb folded; 5 open hand; 6 thumb+pinky; 7 fingertips pinched together; 8 thumb+index (L / pistol); 9 index hooked; 10 fist (or crossed index fingers, which one hand can't do, so use a fist). Check each against a reference for the common mainland forms.

user_request.name: I should just be able to say a particular position... Jarvis peace. Or Jarvis flip me off. Or Jarvis rock on. Or Jarvis surfs up. or Jarvis lululil

summary: Voice commands like "Jarvis peace," "flip me off," "rock on," and "surf's up" should move the left Aero Hand to named poses. The session should run one deterministic, fast command built on performance.py, with poses easy to add and "lululil" confirmed with Jake.
